page.overview:
Who is Adolf Impossible?

Adolf can alter his body's natural composition to nearly any form he chooses.

Has the ability to alter any molecules in his immediate area to an unknown degree. He was once able to trap the auxiliary members of the Fantastic Four inside boxes created entirely with his mind.
